_what: The words the account files' byte release, name retirement, results and WebDAV folder (read and write) say (src/account_files/settings.rs `word`). Each key is the code's name for one refusal or answer; the value is what a person or an AI reads.

words.release_identities: Note files by their identities: a list of 1f: or 12: identities.
words.release_ack: A byte release acknowledgement needs one exact origin and key.
words.release_again: These bytes were being given back while they were written; send them again.
words.release_limit: limit must be a whole number from 1 up to the page bound.
words.forget_name: name must be an absolute name or folder, not the root folder.
words.retire_list: Retire names as a bounded list of exact paths with their expected immutable identities.
words.retire_changed: A temporary name cannot retire while it changed or is still uploading.
words.result_identity: identity must be 1f: or 12: then 64 hex
words.result_kind: kind must be lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
words.result_value_large: value is larger than a result may be
words.result_only_if_absent: only_if_absent must be true or false
words.result_already: A result is already saved for this file and kind. Read it before requesting an intentional replacement.
words.result_write_list: Send results as a bounded list of {identity, kind, value}.
words.result_many: Send { kind, identities } with a bounded list of identities.
words.result_patch: value must be an object of the fields to change
words.result_not_object: this file's result of that kind is not an object, so it has no fields to change
words.result_fields: Name a bounded list of fields of one saved result: lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
words.result_busy: This caller is already reading several results. Try again in a second, or ask for many files at once with read_file_results_many.
words.dav_sign_in: Sign in with your personal key as the password.
words.dav_read_only: These files can only be read here.
words.dav_range: The asked byte range is not in this file.
words.dav_request: A WebDAV request names its method.
words.dav_not_a_write: This is not a WebDAV write.
words.dav_body: A WebDAV write's body_base64 is not base64.
words.dav_precondition: This name is not as the request expected; read it again.
words.dav_too_large: One write here keeps at most 16 MiB; a larger file goes in pieces.
words.dav_no_parent: The folder this goes in does not exist yet.
words.dav_mkcol_body: Making a folder takes no body.
words.dav_root: The top folder cannot be moved, copied or removed.
words.dav_unfinished: Part of this folder was carried; ask again to finish.
words.dav_conflict: A name where this goes already names another file.
words.dav_destination: Say where this goes, below the same folder.
words.dav_onto_itself: A name or folder is never carried onto or into itself.
words.dav_locked: Someone holds a lock on this name; send its lock token, or wait until it ends.
words.dav_not_locked: No lock with that token holds this name.
